Kerala's Congress-led UDF government has completed six months in office, but questions remain over its pace of governance and delivery on key promises. While the government points to higher tax revenues, welfare measures and its Mission Samudra maritime initiative as achievements, it faces criticism over policy decisions, financial constraints and internal differences. Has Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan's government delivered on its promise of transformation, or is it still struggling to get going?
Thank you for watching our video!
